description: Estimate homolytic bond dissociation energies (gas phase, 298 K) in kcal/mol and kJ/mol, weakest bond first, with the basis of each value. By default every X–H bond and every acyclic single bond between heavy atoms. These are the same estimates as the Lone Pair editor's BDE tool: Blanksby & Ellison reference values with additive radical-stabilization terms, and the Sanderson/Reusch R–X compilation; expect about ±2–3 kcal/mol. Where no specific value exists, an average bond enthalpy is given and marked. Call this instead of searching the web for an estimate, and say the numbers are estimates. Atoms are numbered from 1 in the order the input writes them (SMILES order). Not for pKa (use estimate_pka) or reaction energies.

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

atoms.description: The X–H bonds at these atoms (numbered from 1 in input order).

bonds.description: Bonds between heavy atoms, each a pair of atom numbers, e.g. [[1, 2]].

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Short text that is valid SMILES (such as "CO") is read as SMILES, with a note, and not sent. Default false.

name: estimate_bde
title: Estimate bond dissociation energies
